description: Merge one cluster into another: reassigns the source cluster's keywords, roadmap items (and their briefs, which follow transitively), and any linked blog articles to the target cluster, then deletes the source cluster. Not undoable. Housekeeping op — not part of the main flow. Use when seo_list_clusters or a rescan report shows near-duplicate clusters that should be consolidated. The target cluster's own name/description/keywordsMeta/contentMix are NOT changed by the merge — only the FK relations (keyword.clusterId, roadmap.clusterId, blogArticle.clusterId) move over. Use seo_edit_cluster afterward if the target's keywordsMeta needs updating to include the newly reassigned keywords.

clusterId.description: Target cluster ID (survives the merge) — from seo_list_clusters

sourceClusterId.description: Source cluster ID (deleted after its content is reassigned to clusterId)

name: seo_merge_clusters
